bathAction.title: Wash spinneret
bathAction.tooltip: Wash the spinneret, careful around the opening.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(wash)] around [npc.her] [npc.spinneret], careful at the opening, and [npc.verb(rinse)] away what had gathered there. [npc.She] [npc.verb(keep)] the water gentle. [npc.speech(Around the opening. Carefully. It clogs if you rush it.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(let)] warm water run over [npc.her] [npc.spinneret] and [npc.verb(wash)] the opening with a light touch, shivering at the sensitivity. [npc.speech(Gentle. That spot feels everything.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(rinse)] [npc.her] [npc.spinneret] clean in a few firm passes and [npc.verb(move)] on before it can start to feel like more than washing. [npc.speech(Clear it out. That is all.)]
